note: Wounded. condition. At 0 health after failing to Endure Harm, this severe injury requires treatment and prevents health recovery until cleared. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)
Shaken. condition. At 0 spirit after failing to Endure Stress, this distressed state requires comfort and prevents spirit recovery until cleared. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)
Unprepared. condition. When supply reaches 0, the traveling group marks this condition and cannot recover supply until it is cleared. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)
Encumbered. condition. Excessive or cumbersome weight marks this condition, which is cleared by lightening the load. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
Maimed. condition. A permanent injury or disfiguring scar creates ongoing physical and narrative limitations. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
Corrupted. condition. Permanent emotional scarring may change the character’s outlook, behavior, or goals. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
Cursed. condition. Returning from death with a soul-bound quest marks this burden, which only completing the quest clears. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)
Tormented. condition. After facing desolation, this burden binds the character to a quest to prevent a dire future. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)
